      select distinct "garment_wear"."garment_id" as garment_id, "garment_wear"."day" as day
      from "garment_wear"
      join "garment" on "garment"."id" = "garment_wear"."garment_id"
      where "garment_wear"."owner_id" = $1
        and "garment"."status" = $2
        and "garment_wear"."day" >= $3
        and "garment_wear"."day" <= $4
    )
    select one.garment_id as a, other.garment_id as b, count(*)::int as days
    from worn one

    group by one.garment_id, other.garment_id
    having count(*) >= $5
    order by days desc, a, b
    limit $6
